summary: Master EQ-i 2.0 and leadership strategies for senior bankers. Improve negotiations, manage conduct risk, and lead resilient teams. Register today.
lede: Emotional intelligence training for bankers focuses on self-awareness, self-regulation and relationship skills for high-pressure financial work. Designed for experienced financial professionals in strategy, client management or team leadership, it covers managing reactions to market stress, using empathy in client relationships, influencing stakeholders and supporting teams through change.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced financial professionals who operate at the intersection of strategy, client management, and team leadership.
modules: Emotional Intelligence in the Banking Ecosystem
Social Awareness and Client Relationship Management
Influence and Persuasion in Capital Markets
Leading Hybrid and Global Banking Teams
EQ in Risk Management and Conduct Culture
prerequisites: Participants should hold a senior management or director-level position within a financial institution. A minimum of 10 years of experience in banking or capital markets is recommended. Prior exposure to basic leadership theory is helpful but not required.
